subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` remove persisted plugin install records solely because the primary recorded install/source path is missing?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive state repair: the patch is focused and proven, but it changes what an operator-run doctor repair may delete from existing user state.

options.title: Accept Missing-Path Cleanup
options.body: Proceed after branch refresh if maintainers agree that absent primary install/source paths mean the install record is stale and should be removed before registry rebuild.

options.title: Narrow To Reporting First
options.body: Ask the contributor to keep the health finding but defer record deletion until a separate maintainer-approved repair policy lands.

options.title: Prefer Reinstall-First Semantics
options.body: Pause this PR and design doctor to reinstall or repair matching configured official plugins before deleting the stale record.

recommendation.title: Accept Missing-Path Cleanup
recommendation.body: Proceed after branch refresh if maintainers agree that absent primary install/source paths mean the install record is stale and should be removed before registry rebuild.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice centers on installed-plugin index persistence and upgrade-state semantics, where vincentkoc is the strongest adjacent history signal available in this checkout.
